gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada reads friendly and current, with a soft step up into its capitals and curves that open wide at both ends. And Amatic SC scrawls above it in thin, quirky pen lines, so the page feels hand-lettered on top and tidy below.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li has brush-like ends that lift away before each curve closes, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. But Amatic SC above it is all wiry, handwritten strokes, so make the body text a touch larger to hold its own.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi reads as a dark, sturdy stripe of lowercase, its curves left open instead of closing up. And Amatic SC is the one for wiry, rustic flair, while the body font does the steady everyday carrying.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Spindly marker lines meet chunky, notched openness. But Amatic SC is best at quirky, hand-drawn character, while Noto Sans Khmer is best at carrying text in tall, proud lowercase that stays crisp and modern.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC looks cut from wire. Noto Sans Khojki sits beneath it with wide exits and a big, clear eye on every e, so the scrappy heading never crowds the clean text.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Amatic SC's lines hold one marker-like thickness, even down the tail of its y. It is built for hand-drawn personality, while Noto Sans Khudawadi does the quiet work of tidy text with its unlatched, open rounds.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-kr: Amatic SC draws its letters like solder pulled through a nozzle, thin and wiry and unmistakably handmade. Noto Sans KR gives them generous curves and a big x-height to lean on.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-lao: Amatic SC draws rustic, quirky letters with no hairlines and no swelling anywhere. Yet Noto Sans Lao follows with a high x-height and open mouths, so a long passage would read smoothly and modern.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Noto Sans Lao Looped reads in solid blocks, bowls left open on one side. Amatic SC adds a rustic, quirky hand with no brush-like swelling, and that gap in character is what makes the pair work.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Approachable and sturdy, Noto Sans Lepcha has wide-open curves and a lowercase with real cast-iron stature. And Amatic SC floats above it in thin, constant strokes, giving the page a rustic, quirky hand against that weight.
